dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: A' sits before the origin grid A (roof eave 1.00m north of A) — kept a negative pos_m (-1.00) rather than letting it take over the origin, per the standing rule.
dummy_grid_rule_check.prime_ordering: Two independent dummy lines fall in the single 'beyond C' gap: the roof eave (1.00m south of C = 6.40) and the balcony/stair-landing edge (1.20m south of C = 6.60). Ordered by ascending pos_m (scan direction top-to-bottom): roof eave = C' (6.40), balcony edge = C'' (6.60).
